text: Deep, well-documented bill pay with exact screen names, eBills, variable-amount AutoPay and a late-fee guarantee [S009, S018].

Real-Time Bill Pay (RTP Request for Payment from enrolled billers, authorized in the Mobile app, irrevocable) is contractually documented in the DSA but not marketed on pnc.com; biller coverage unknown [S018, S906].
Low Cash Mode Payment Control lets customers pay/return individual ACH and check items when negative - a distinctive money-movement control [S013, S061].
Self-service domestic and international wires in both Online Banking and the mobile app, plus a $5 LatAm remittance product with Spanish UI and cash pickup via branch [S004, S007, S010].
Zelle feature completeness: send/request/split, QR send and receive, Zelle Ready Contacts, widgets, business Zelle tags, future-dated and recurring Zelle [S002, S003, S017, S023].
PNC Express Funds: transparent fee-based instant availability for mobile and ATM check deposits with no debit if the check returns NSF [S005, S046].

Commercial: founding RTP member with full six-message-type RTP (incl. RFP), Intelligent Routing, ePayments, Direct to Debit Card, Zelle Disbursements, and FedNow since Oct 2025; PINACLE dual approval, token passcodes and mobile approvals [S027, S031, S032, S055].

Unusually transparent commercial documentation: 62 public Treasury Management service schedules (ePayments, Intelligent Routing, PINACLE Transaction Initiation, Bill Payment, Verification Services, etc.) plus a public API catalog with Zelle Lookup, Request For Payment, Webhooks and an ePayments initiate/status/cancel API [S907, S908, S910, S911, S923].

ePayments gives B2C payees seven payout choices including PayPal/Venmo and Direct to Debit (Visa), with Payee Approver controls, expiration and check fallback, and reconciliation identifiers mapped to BAI2 [S908, S909].

Consumer international transfers carry a documented 30-minute cancel, Date Available on the receipt and 180-day error window (Reg E), and the self-service wire agreement spells out the step-up menu (OTP, debit card data, PIN/PII, callback) [S905].

Quick Switch Center imports bill-pay payees from the old bank and generates direct-deposit/autopay switch letters; Early Pay (up to 2 business days) needs no enrollment and can be switched off in 'Account Actions' [S921, S919].

PNC publishes click-through simulations of its new Online Banking (transfers, external transfers, credit-card payment, domestic and international wires, Bill Pay, alerts) with exact screen labels and confirmation text [S975-S982].
External ACH transfers settle in 3-4 banking days with no expedited or instant option and trial-deposit verification [S006, S018].
Zelle is mobile-app only; no web Zelle send documented — the 2026 Online Banking tutorial set's Zelle item only points users to the mobile app [S002, S004, S975].

Wire marketing/FAQ pages carry no cutoff, tracking or cancel information; these live only in the Self-Service Wire and Money Transfer Agreement (8:30 a.m.-6:00 p.m. ET processing; best-effort cancel), and no wire fraud-reimbursement stance is published [S010, S905].
No consumer push-to-card instant transfer (Visa Direct) product; no PayPal/Venmo account linking or Apple Cash guidance [S039, S040].
Bill pay UI is fragmented into three variants (Bill Pay Dashboard; two 'Pay Bills Summary' experiences) [S009].
Alerts page lists no transfer-/Zelle-/wire-specific alert types [S015].
The phased 'new app experience' (v5.0+, rolled out May-Sep 2026) has drawn negative App Store reviews about clutter and small text (COMMUNITY) [S034].
Legacy Virtual Wallet automations (Savings Engine, Punch the Pig, Danger Days, Wish List) no longer appear anywhere on pnc.com [S011, S012, S059].

Self-service domestic/business wires: no written confirmation or receipt unless required by law, no tracking states, and 'no absolute right to cancel or amend' once received - cancellation is a best-effort phone/branch request [S905].

Scam-claim intake is phone/branch only (no online or in-app scam/dispute form for Zelle or wires); the imposter-scam reimbursement stance appears only in the Zelle Terms of Use, and the in-flow scam interstitial could not be verified [S903, S017].
Texting STOP to 762265 silences Zelle payment/request texts together with Account Alerts and Text Banking; fraud-prevention confirmations are not manageable in the alert center [S922, S906].

Fall 2026 app-store reviews report crashes, 'temporarily unavailable' biometrics, generic error messages replacing specific validation errors, and navigation complaints after the redesign; Zelle has no web fallback [S917, S918] (COMMUNITY).

Several key commercial schedules (Instant Payments Service, Direct to Debit Card Service, Wire Transfer/Funds Transfer Service) and the Consumer Funds Availability Policy are published as image-only PDFs, so FedNow/RTP send-receive terms and push-to-card rules remain unreadable [S907, S051].
Warren 2022 staff report: PNC refunded 14% of unauthorized-transaction Zelle claims (1,495 of 10,683; $1.46M of over $10.6M), 2021–H1 2022, the lowest share of the banks reporting [S966].
Low Cash Mode (Extra Time + Payment Control) as a payments-decisioning tool [S013].
Real-Time Bill Pay via RTP Request for Payment for consumers [S018].
Virtual Wallet Calendar / Money Bar 'Scheduled Out' integrates scheduled payments into cash-flow visualization [S012, S060].
LatAm International Money Transfers at $5 with branch cash pickup [S007].
Zelle tags for businesses; Zelle-over-RTP pioneer with BofA (2021) [S023, S054].
Treasury Intelligent Routing across RTP / wire / Same Day ACH / ACH [S055].
Zelle Lookup API and Bank Routing Number Verification (with RTP eligibility) let corporate clients pre-validate payees before disbursing [S923].
White-labeled ePayments payee portal (client's own terms/privacy, no PNC branding; 'Pay Choice' consent copy) with SMS OTP delivery to payees [S908].
2025-10-21: PNC joined the FedNow Service (send and receive per PYMNTS), one of the last large banks to do so [S031, S042, S043].

2026-05-15 to 2026-10-14: PNC Mobile 'new app experience' released in phases from v5.0.0/5.1.0 (May 15-Jun 9, 2026); the 'released in phases' note disappeared at v5.6.0 (Oct 14, 2026); v5.7.0 shipped ~Nov 5, 2026 [S917].
Paze wallet live for PNC cards with in-app management (More > Paze) [S038].
Zelle Terms of Use reference reimbursement for 'certain qualifying imposter scams' (EWS network policy) [S017].
Zelle standalone app retirement (April 2025): PNC business Zelle page notes businesses cannot transact with Zelle-app-only users [S023].
App 4.62 (Feb 10, 2026): push notifications for all available PNC alerts; app 4.61 (Dec 4, 2025): 24/7 debit card lock/unlock [S917].
Self-Service Wire and Money Transfer Agreement effective June 3, 2025; Digital Services Agreement effective July 25, 2025 [S905, S906].

ePayments Service schedule Version April 2026 lists PayPal/Venmo and Direct to Debit (Visa) among payee-choice methods; Intelligent Routing schedule Version March 2026 adds reroute option for returned Instant Payments [S908, S910].
PNC Early Pay 'will be added in a phased rollout to checking and savings accounts through December 2026' [S921].
PNC Bank, N.A. appears in the FRB FedNow participant list as of 2026-11-02 [S915].
2025-10-29: PNC and Visa announced a renewed collaboration giving Treasury Management clients immediate payments via Visa Direct (Direct to Debit Card via API and ePayments) [S952, S953].
2026-01-05: PNC completed its acquisition of FirstBank ($26.8B assets); ~780,000 customers and 95 branches converted to PNC platforms by June 2026 [S956, S957].
2025-07-01 (context): Sens. Warren and Blumenthal and Rep. Waters asked PNC for Zelle scam reimbursement data and policies; no public PNC response found [S958].
PNC is an EWS owner; NY AG v. EWS survived dismissal Jul 20, 2026 (no PNC-specific allegations reported) [S964].
Nacha Phase 1/2 fraud-monitoring rules effective Mar 20 / Jun 19, 2026 [S969].
In-flow Zelle/wire scam interstitial wording: not discoverable from any public PNC page, video or PDF; requires an authenticated session.

FedNow send vs receive: the FRB participant file no longer carries send/receive/RFP flags and the FedNow Explorer network search is gone; PNC's own texts never say 'send' explicitly; the API catalog still names RTP only.
Instant Payments Service, Direct to Debit Card Service and Wire Transfer/Funds Transfer Service schedules are image-only PDFs (every word rendered as an image) - would need OCR.
Pay Receive Sync Services Agreement (PRS Agreement) referenced by the DSA could not be located; Pay Receive Sync platform vendor unknown.
Consumer Funds Availability Policy PDF is image-only; the Checking & Savings FAQ table was used instead.
Legacy Virtual Wallet automations (Savings Engine, Punch the Pig, Danger Days, Wish List) still not found; Virtual Wallet Student retired (404) in favour of PNC Simple Checking.

PNC-C010: Does the PNC Mobile app expose future-dated/recurring Zelle payments? Zelle Terms v2.7 (Feb 2026) s.9 says yes; PNC's live popmoney-to-zelle page says Zelle does not offer them; the consumer guide is silent. Needs an authenticated app check or a current PNC FAQ [S017, S951, S003].

PNC-C020: Are there two or three live Bill Pay UIs? The bill pay page documents two account-type paths (Virtual Wallet/Cash Flow Insight vs other) plus a 'Bill Pay Dashboard' that may be shared; needs authenticated views [S009].

PNC Online Banking wire walkthrough shows debit/banking-card identity verification for domestic wires but OTP for international transfers; the Self-Service Wire agreement allows either - which method applies by channel/risk is not published [S979, S980, S905].
Can a PNC Zelle requester cancel a pending request? No PNC page, FAQ or Terms section describes it [S984, S985, S017].
